LanguageData.DMS_BullHound_ShotgunMounted.label: mounted KS-23
LanguageData.DMS_BullHound_ShotgunMounted.description:
A KS-23 carbine shotgun fixed to a bullhound's back mount. Its 23x75mmR shells are built to stop intruders in corridors and doorways outright.
This weapon is designed specifically for mounted use, so only specific units can equip it.
